name: Eftel
summary: ISP (formerly Datafast) that grew by acquisitions; completed a reverse takeover by ClubTelco 2011 (ClubTelco interests took 75.6% of the listed shell); acquired by M2 Group 2013, closed 2022.

events.details: Predecessor Datafast commenced in Victoria; Eftel ISP brand from 2000 in Perth.
Reverse takeover by ClubTelco 2011; acquired by M2 Group (~A$44.1m); business unit closed 2022.
